verdict.rationale: HubSpot offers its own headless interfaces: an npm-installable CLI (`hs init`) and REST endpoints such as `POST /crm/v3/objects/contacts`, which scripts and pipelines can call without the UI. Test accounts also let integrations run without touching real data. The evidence never documents CI use itself, and the CLI flow shown is an interactive 'Authorize your HubSpot account' step. Missing for 10: documented non-interactive or CI authentication (tokens or env vars for the CLI), CI pipeline examples or integrations (e.g. GitHub Actions), and independent hands-on corroboration of headless CI runs.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can run the product headlessly / in CI for automation

citations.quote: To create one contact, make a `POST` request to `/crm/v3/objects/contacts`.
